summary: German fantasy RPG line that began as single-player The Dark Eye computer RPGs before becoming the separate Drakensang Online action MMORPG.

entries.title: Drakensang: The Dark Eye
entries.definitive_edition: No separate definitive edition; use the Windows PC release

primary.why: The game is Windows-only, so the native PC version is both the complete and highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release with compatibility fixes applied if needed on modern Windows.

all_releases.reason: primary: only documented platform and best capture route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is the only documented release platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; modern play may require compatibility fixes.

entries.title: Drakensang: The River of Time
entries.definitive_edition: No remaster; play the Windows release with Phileasson's Secret available as DLC

primary.version: Windows PC release with Phileasson's Secret DLC available separately
primary.why: The River of Time is Windows-only; the PC version is the only and highest-fidelity route, with Phileasson's Secret available as the add-on chapter.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Steam release and add Phileasson's Secret if covering the complete Drakensang single-player arc.

all_releases.reason: primary: only documented platform and complete route when paired with its DLC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is the only documented release platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; modern systems may need compatibility tuning.

entries.title: Drakensang: Phileasson's Secret
entries.definitive_edition: No separate definitive edition; this is the add-on chapter for The River of Time

emulation.notes: Run through the Windows base game installation.

primary.version: Windows DLC for Drakensang: The River of Time
primary.why: Phileasson's Secret is a Windows-only expansion chapter for The River of Time and has no separate platform choice.
primary.how_to_play: Install Drakensang: The River of Time on Windows, then install Phileasson's Secret from Steam or another legitimate PC source before playing the add-on chapter.

all_releases.fidelity: Windows DLC/add-on chapter requiring The River of Time.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is the only documented platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; requires the base game.

entries.title: Drakensang Online

emulation.notes: No emulation needed; live-service availability and account access are the limiting factors.

primary.why: The live game is actively updated on the official site and Windows is the clearest current client route for capture.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official Drakensang Online site/download on Windows and verify live-service status before planning a stream segment.

all_releases.fidelity: Current downloadable/live-service route for the action MMORPG.
all_releases.reason: primary: active official site and best capture path.

all_releases.fidelity: Historically documented Mac route for the online game.
all_releases.reason: skip: no exclusive content and less clear current capture/support path than Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: For the live service, Windows is the practical current route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Drakensang Online is not a The Dark Eye sequel despite sharing the brand; it uses a separate world and live-service structure.
